integrity: Self-contained written necessity/sufficiency proof; exact standard-library script enumerates all 128 parameter choices, 29 valid labeled cases and five dihedral orbits. The finite computation is not used as a proof about arbitrary finite spaces. All calculations and their stdout are embedded.
scientific_limitations: Only finite spaces containing an induced complement of a seven-cycle and only minimum 14-point equality cases are classified. The five types are homeomorphism types; wedges classify the order complexes and weak homotopy types only. The edge-clique cover number seven and related fourteen-point bound are prior-implied, not claimed novel. Longer antiholes and independent priority validation are outside scope.
title: Five minimal finite-space models realizing the seven-antihole
